messages.content: How do I connect my weather station to Wi-Fi?
Hold the pairing button on the display for three seconds until the Wi-Fi icon blinks, then open the Temper Home app and choose Add device.
The app shows -- for outside temperature. What do I do?
That means the outdoor sensor has lost contact. Move it within 80 metres of the display and replace its batteries, then it should reconnect within a minute.
Can I export a week of readings as a CSV?
Yes. Open the history screen, pick the date range, then tap Export. The file lands in your Downloads folder.
My rainfall readings seem too low after a storm.
The tipping bucket can clog with leaves. Remove the funnel and rinse the bucket, then run the calibration test from the settings menu.
Does the station work without the app?
The display shows live readings on its own. The app adds history, alerts, and remote viewing, but none of those are required for basic use.
How often does the display refresh?
Indoor and outdoor readings refresh every 10 seconds, and the app polls every 30 seconds.
The wind speed always reads 0.
Check that the anemometer cups spin freely. If the axle is stiff, a drop of silicone oil on the bearing usually fixes it.
Can two phones use the same station?
Yes. Share the station from the settings menu; the second phone joins with its own login and both stay in sync.
The display backlight stays on all night. Can I dim it?
Yes. Set a schedule under Display, or turn on auto-dimming, which uses your location's sunset time.
What does the dew point reading tell me?
It is the temperature at which moisture condenses. A dew point close to the air temperature means high humidity and a good chance of fog.
My station reports the wrong date after a power cut.
It re-syncs the clock from the network within a minute of power returning. If it does not, check that the Wi-Fi is connected and wait for the next sync cycle.
Can I mount the outdoor sensor on a metal pole?
Metal can reflect the wireless signal. Mount it at least 30 cm from any metal surface for a reliable connection.
